needed.evidence: No continuous sidewalk; people and parked cars share the edge of the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a 1.5 m paved footway on the left, set back from the parked cars.

needed.evidence: The right edge is an uneven dirt strip with no defined path.
needed.suggestion: Lay a 1.5 m concrete footway along the right side in front of the unfinished building.

needed.evidence: A row of parked vehicles occupies the only usable strip on the left.
needed.suggestion: Mark a no-parking zone on the left to keep the footway clear.

needed.evidence: A parked pickup and construction materials block the right edge.
needed.suggestion: Provide a designated parking bay away from the right footway.

needed.evidence: Broken paving and debris are scattered along the left edge.
needed.suggestion: Resurface the left footway to remove the broken sections.

needed.evidence: Loose rubble and uneven ground are visible on the right.
needed.suggestion: Clear the rubble and level the right footway.

needed.evidence: People are seen crossing at an unmarked point with no facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at the junction with dropped kerbs.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs are visible at the crossing point.
needed.suggestion: Add dropped kerbs at both ends of the new crossing.
